The Apple Park Visitor Center store got a fresh batch of merch today ahead of next week’s WWDC, when Apple is expected to welcome more than 1,000 developers, students, journalists, and other guests to its campus.

Pre-WWDC merch drop

Even though Apple stopped holding live keynotes years ago, the company still brings hundreds of people to Apple Park during WWDC, including developers, students, media members, and other guests.

This year, visitors who swing by the store located at the Apple Park Visitor Center will get a chance to buy some brand-new merch, including hats, crewnecks, and water bottles.

As spotted by Mr. Macintosh on X (via MacRumors), the new merch hit the shelves earlier today, and they were among the first to check them out:

The Apple Park Visitor Center store features products that aren’t sold anywhere else in the world, and during events like WWDC, they can sell out quickly. So if you’re attending WWDC in person and are hoping to pick up one of the new items, you should probably do that sooner rather than later.

As seen in Mr. Macintosh’s pictures, the new rainbow Garamond crewnecks are available in black or white, in sizes XS through 3XL, for $80. The rainbow Apple logo hat, also available in black or white, sells for $40, while the new reusable stainless steel Apple water bottle, available in two colors, also goes for $40.

Are you going to WWDC? Will you get the new merch? Let us know in the comments.
